_meta.description: Fixture list of IAM roles ZeroShift Part 2 manages. In fixture mode, the shared iam_role_client resolves these entries; in real mode it queries IAM directly and filters by the ManagedBy=ZeroShift tag. The 'zeroshift-demo-app-role' entry is the CDK-deployed real role that LOW-risk remediation actually mutates.

roles.description: CDK-deployed target role. LOW-risk remediation calls iam:CreatePolicyVersion + iam:SetDefaultPolicyVersion against attachedPolicyArn.
Fixture-only. Kicks a MEDIUM-tier remediation path (wildcard scope reduction on s3).
Fixture-only. Kicks HIGH-tier remediation path (prod tag + admin-adjacent removal). Requires human approval.
Fixture-only. Non-prod tag, unused-only drift, LOW-tier (fixture no-op apply).
